city_map.name: city map
city_map.description: A pocket map showing transit lines, public buildings, and the blocks surrounding the plaza.

paper_cup.name: paper coffee cup
paper_cup.description: An empty recyclable cup with the café’s simple blue logo.

community_flyer.name: community flyer
community_flyer.description: A flyer for a neighborhood repair café this Saturday at the library. Small print along the bottom: 'Bring one broken thing. We will show you how, not do it for you.'

broken_lamp.name: broken desk lamp
broken_lamp.description: A small desk lamp with a frayed cord, wrapped in tape that stopped helping a while ago. The switch has to be held down to stay on.

mended_lamp.name: mended desk lamp
mended_lamp.description: The same small desk lamp with a new cord, a re-seated socket, and a strip of masking tape on the base in someone else's handwriting: 'Fixed at the library. Keep it dry.'

properties.use_text: You click the switch once. The lamp comes on and stays on, the way it is supposed to.
